chapter: Moten band, arranging and the guitar
title: First electric guitar on the Kansas City Six sides
summary: His first electric guitar came with Bon Bon's Buddies and the Kansas City Six on Hello Little Girl, though instruments were poor then.

bands.name: Bon Bon Tunnell and His Buddies

story.theme_name: Banjo, guitar and the rhythm section: instruments and players
story.community_name: Banjo, guitar and the rhythm section's changing role

blocks.x: Well, when did you start to use the regular sort of amplified electric guitar?
When I got my first -- I never did get a good one with those bands. First time I got an electric guitar was at Bob Barnie's Buddies and in there. Now, those electric guitars --
Kansas City Six, in (Hello, Little Girl).
(Unintelligible.) And they still wasn't perfected good at that time. It was kind of bad.
Well, what I'm trying to come around to is, where -- when does that electric guitar thing come in, like T-Bone Walker and Charlie Christian?
That's what I'm trying to figure.
